rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ADHarman
Exhibition name: Lasting Love ® (hybrid tea, Adam, 1993)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, 1993).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2005.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Strong, fruity, rose fragrance. 24 to 34 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very double, borne mostly solitary, cupped, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
